title: GitaChatBot
summary: A personal project: a conversational chatbot that answers life questions with insights from the Bhagavad Gita, using embeddings in FAISS.
overview: A chatbot built with FastAPI, a Gemini model and a vector index. Users register, log in and ask questions; responses use embeddings stored in FAISS and S3.
problem: Answers about a long text are more useful when grounded in the text itself. This project indexes the source material so the model can respond from relevant passages.
approach: A script (create_embeddings_from_pdf.py) builds embeddings from PDF source material.
FAISS provides vector indexing for faster retrieval; embeddings and indexes are stored on Amazon S3.
MongoDB stores user data and conversations; users can register, log in and log out.
The Gemini model generates the responses.

architecture.label: Backend
architecture.detail: Python FastAPI with the Gemini model.

architecture.label: Vector search and storage
architecture.detail: FAISS for indexing; Amazon S3 for embeddings and FAISS indexes; MongoDB for users and conversations.

workflow.step: Source PDFs are converted to embeddings and indexed in FAISS.
A user asks a question in the web interface.
Relevant content is retrieved and the Gemini model generates the response.

items: Built this personal project, per the public repository.

limitations: Details come from the project's public README on GitHub; no usage numbers, accuracy figures or deployment results are claimed.
The README lists voice interaction, more source books and cloud deployment as future enhancements, so they are not claimed.
